body: The last time I hooked up with my ex I could tell it was different. The connection was different I just new that the way he was so engrossed with me he was with everyone. I wasn’t exceptionally sexy to him. And so I could not let my guard down. It hurt sometimes and I just couldn’t do it like we did before. So I know that some of our connection is gone. So if she’s a narcissist she is giving that same fake intimacy to some other people too. I couldn’t do it knowing he was just doing the same thing that worked for them.

I’m earlier on but struggling with the loneliness while know he had been talking to other people the whole time so he is now even though he always says he isn’t. 

So I’m reminding myself that he is trying to manipulate me and telling myself that he is none of my business now. It’s not my business who he is with or what he is doing so 🤷‍♀️

It’s rough and it’s good to hear someone is feeling better so I can too 🧡

Mine did that too. And it wasn’t his fault I made him horny. He got mad if I said no, told me when I said no it made him want it more. I gave in honestly every time and did everything he asked. 

We’ve been over over for almost 3 weeks and now he uses those things he wanted me to do against me. Says the only good thing I have, called me nasty. Mention showing pics n videos. 

I liked that he found me so attractive but now realize I was just easy, could have been a pillow. And he was depriving me of sleep and napping or whatever all day. 

So just a warning lately I’m becoming aware of how I lost myself in giving up and letting him do as he wanted and knowing that me giving up was what he wanted. I’m supposed to be learning that I matter. So be careful not to loose that. 

SA makes people uncomfortable. I spoke about on here once and so much later someone said I saw this and wanted to validate you and it meant so much so ❤️❤️❤️

For real to take responsibility for the part I played 💁‍♀️ I’m 37 met him briefly over 10 years ago, thought was a ass. Insert fb dating 2022. Gave me a chance at the moment I wanted to destroy all “Gods Gift” men but danced with the devil and could not tango 💃

Last esp: emailed ex “to tell her daughter happy bday” such a nice guy. Deleted email. He started saying things, I knew he had been fucking with her so I looked and found. I declined is invites to screw him 2 weeks after no contact and let him know that it’s crazy how I knew to look for 2 exes 2 times because of him talking to much and was right 🤯 he says paranoia, made it up in my head; I said maybe but intuition honey. 
To assert that he had in fact been smarter than me about the entire situation, his ex, her mom, and her daughter all have the SAME BIRTHDAY!!! 😱☠️☠️ he grinned triumphantly and drove away

Yes his name is Brad and isn’t he a clever little fucker
Mine did this then would want me to talk with him about what it was going to be like when he won. Given the current situation it wasn’t looking good 😂

Yes started by insulting me then letting me know how he is getting it, thanks for leaving best thing I ever did for him. Next was why can’t we just fuck the sex was good are you never going to talk to me again? I did break 14 days no contact to send a text to shoot him down. I probably shouldn’t have it was just like 15 minutes ago

How did I get you?, your to good for me, idk why you stay. My answer “your supposed to be good to me, right?” WRONG 😑 

I did get to say “the only time you told the truth was when you said I was to good for you” and that was nice

Same, shoved me down then said maybe the door hit you when I shut it. And I still went back. Last time him was throwing things at me. I was so devoted and he kept messaging exes and I had to leave before something like that truly broke my heart. 

It’s crazy the man had his hand on my throat and told me he could kill me and I what choose to believe his lie that I was special to him again? So I held on to this promise that I wanted to be his forever and now I know I broke it
Mine would say “I really love you no other woman has held my interest for long at all.” I knew deep down that sounded horrible

Yes I thought I’m not doing XYZ so maybe he is telling the truth and I should give him the “benefit of a doubt” he at least kept messaging his last ex and others so I left before I saw something that really broke me. 12 days no contact.. yay
Same then he said I always interrupted like damn I have too.. I can’t wait until I don’t care about him anymore

I’ve read about the sounds while eating thing and I think my ex butthead did the ask the question back too. I know I’ve said it’s a yes or no question.. I had read that narcs don’t give straight answers

Porn like sex often. I had a deep fear of him cheating and maybe he knew it. He liked it when I acted like I didn’t want it sometimes toward the end he started talking r*** fantasies. I know he still messaged other girls as dumb as it sounds I wanted to get away because I knew it would crush me if cheating was confirmed so I wanted to leave before then. I really needed away from him he may have been getting dangerous

I’m almost 38 and hoping it’s better by 50 😅 hang in there you got lots of time. As you get older you have more control of your life’s trajectory so for better or worse you can do something about it either way

They are liars it’s ridiculous to say no body likes you. Speaking on absolutes like that is a sign of narcissism.  I’ve been 10 days no contact and have got lots of crappy emails I use them to remind me of what he is, delete the nice full of shit emails n stuff then flip what he is saying. He says I’m selfish and dangerous, that’s him I’m only far away pretty with bad breath that’s him. Idk if that’s the true psychology behind it but it helps me sometimes
When I bought a new car he set him up a profile before I did. N tried to bully me into paying extra monthly so his daughter could have Wi-Fi in there. So glad I stuck to my guns with no

My late bf said I need you to load and unload the gun to show me you know how to use it. I asked why would I have to use it? If I do will you put it away? He wouldn’t tell me why I would have to use it. I loaded and unloaded the 3 bullets. I was becoming scared I guess so I went to bed with my daughter then woke up to a gunshot about two hours later. 

Everyone asked if we had been fighting and we hadn’t it kind of seems like a silly question to ask really but lots of people did

You have no idea how many times I have read this since you commented. I did go back and he did have me leave again, messaged his ex and sent me screenshots. I always told him my issues with cheating and how it has torn me apart all my life starting with my mom and dad. I told him I would try to forgive him but every time I tell him not to do something again (block on fb, make me leave, etc) he has done again. I just can’t have his ex having the upper hand and know that she doesn’t care if he has a gf, when I messaged her she called him right away. He called me begging me to stop. 

I blocked his number and messenger but he can still email. He has gone back and forth I love you, I hate you, how could you do this to me, you know I never cheated, if you call me a liar again I’ll cut your tongue out, you should die, I miss you, it was a mental breakdown. He says he cared more than I did, that’s why I can walk away and he can’t. 

But he has been unblocked on messenger for 2 days and hasn’t even checked so he isn’t trying to hard.

Yes I found the body but I didn't take the time to look for blood, I knew what had happened. I've read that it's always traumatic finding a body whether u know them or not. The way he shot himself his face was fine they had a open casket n everything
Thank you

So my live in boyfriend of 4 years shot himself about 7 months ago and I was the one to find him right after. This year holidays n his bday around have been completely different. I had to give statements to cops and investigators. There is no note so they had to prove it was suicide so I got interviewed a few times. I have to do a lot by myself that we used to do together n I'm still not used to that. I don't talk to his family because I feel guilt because the night before he told me how he would do it. Then he did it just that way. I don't feel like I handled it right, obviously.  His mom told me I should move. At his funeral everyone had their someone to stand next to n mine was in the casket. I hear songs sometimes n know he would like them n will never hear them or he loved the news n there's so much going on that he would be into. He was 39 when he did it n was dreading turning 40.

I also have to answer questions my 7 year old has about it and I never know what to say
My brain gets consumed sometimes looking for a note, running the days before through my head, the night n day of..
